name: Kaiju Containment Crew
summary:
Jump into the ultimate city destruction sandbox - Kaiju Containment Crew!

Time for destruction - play as a massive Kaiju and level the city and destroy all that gets in your way, including a relentless army that gets more powerful as you go on. 

4 player co-op - play with friends in private lobbies or strangers in public, or practice on your own and use cheats! Play catch with buses full of civilians or blast helicopters out of the sky together.
